contexts.text: Some from habit, and some from contempt, use the things of Holy Scripture as formulas of jokes or mocking... But such thoughts and sayings adjoin themselves to their corporeal and filthy ideas, and in the other life inflict on them much injury; for they return, together with the profane things. Such undergo the penalty of tearing asunder, until they desist from such things. SE 1304.
